content: KeePass: free open-source, fully local, no internet required, single encrypted database file (.kdbx) using AES-256/ChaCha20/Twofish with SHA-256 key derivation. Auth via master password and/or key file, optional Windows-account lock. Built-in password generator, plugin architecture for extensibility. Security-by-transparency: all algorithms published/auditable, no proprietary black box.
